newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Total U.S. money market mutual fund assets rose to $953.32 billion this week from a revised $947.86 billion last week, an industry trade group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 659 retail money market mutual funds fell $1.02 billion to $628.86 billion in the week.

Of the retail funds, assets of the 398 taxable money market funds fell $997.5 million to $511.74 billion, while assets of the 261 tax-exempt funds fell $22.9 million to $117.11 billion, the group said.

The Institute said assets of the 319 institutional money market funds rose $6.47 billion to $324.46 billion. Of these, assets of the 256 taxable money market funds increased $6.39 billion to $292.24 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds rose $79.6 million to $32.22 billion, it said.
The Institute revised last week's money market mutual fund assets to $947.86 billion from $947.28 billion.
